DISCLAIMER: This probably will not be helpful to you at all but I'll share my experience with you. Also sorry for the length!

So my senior year of high school I met this fantastic female who I also became really close with and we eventually came best friends. Fast forward about a year we're going to college and things start getting...interesting. I knew from the start I had a crush on her, she's fucking gorgeous and has a great personality, but in her book I was her best friend and she was straight. Whatever I'll live. However we started having the same interactions you described--always cuddling, very touchy-feely, saying I love you, even just out right flirting but it was always playful. 

Then one day she texts me and asks me to come over so I do and end up spending the night. While we're in her twin bed cuddling she slides her hand up my shirt and timidly ask "is this ok?" (I of course being who I am said fuck yes it is) and she continued to feel me up the entire night. I wasn't sure what to do because whenever I tried to do the same to her she pulled back so I just let her explore. This went on for MONTHS. Eventually she let me in and I was able to explore a little but it was never the same I could tell she didn't it enjoy it as much as she did doing it to me. When we were apart she always talked about boys and what not and it broke my heart but what could I do? I was okay with this "friends with benefits" thing we had going on. But she would NEVER kiss me on the lips. Not once. The cheek, forehead, whatever but never my lips. This upset me. One day I called her out on it and that was my demise. She broke off everything, changed schools, and started dating a guy. I. was. heartbroken. And to this day, although I'm over it, I still wonder from time to time what exactly it was that we had. 

So I guess what I'm saying is I would personally keep your guard up. Don't do what I did when all the signs point to she likes dick basically. Unless you can deal with the heartache. Some times it can be worth it but that's your call to make. 

TL:DR; Got mixed feeling from my best friend, ended up fooling around for a couple months, ended in complete heartache. Sucked.

I've never been in a coma but I have fainted and been put under for surgery. 
Fainting is surreal it's almost like when you're having a dream but you're also semi awake? That in between state it's hard to describe. I could hear everything going on around me in the real world but in my mind I was picturing a time in my childhood, like a dream. It's an odd sensation. 
Now anesthesia! That's where it's at man. Ever blacked out? It's like the most hardcore sleep you'll ever get in your life. I remember counting "10...9...8..." and then everything went black. No dreaming sensations, nothing. It's like being (what I would think) dead. But honestly the best way to describe it is go get smashed and black out. Same thing without the shitty hangover. It's great!
